features.name: white_tactical_advantage_score
features.description: Weighted sum of white tactical indicators: skewr, wkovl, wkpos, wknck, r2ar8 encoded as binary, capturing white's positional and tactical strength
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear combination of key white advantage indicators provides smooth margin signal for SVM

features.name: black_king_vulnerability_score
features.description: Sum of black king vulnerability indicators: bkblk, bknwy, bkon8, bkona, bkspr encoded as binary threats to black king safety
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated black king exposure metric provides continuous severity measure for linear separation

features.name: rook_activity_index
features.description: Composite rook activity score combining rook-related features: rxmsq, rkxwp, rimmx, reskr indicating rook mobility and attacking potential
features.expected_model_benefit: Continuous rook activity measure helps SVM find linear boundary based on rook effectiveness

features.name: black_king_cross_attack_score
features.description: Black king cross-attack indicators: bkxbq, bkxcr, bkxwp, blxwp, bxqsq measuring black king exposure to cross-attacks
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth cross-attack severity score enables linear SVM to exploit attack pattern information

features.name: tactical_threat_density
features.description: Ratio of active tactical threats to total possible tactical features, normalized to [0,1] range for smooth SVM input
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized density ratio provides well-scaled continuous feature ideal for SVM margin optimization

features.name: katri_encoded
features.description: Ordinal encoding of katri (king attack triangle) with n=0, w=1, b=2 to capture directional threat severity
features.expected_model_benefit: Ordinal encoding of three-level categorical preserves ordering information useful for linear SVM

features.name: dwipd_encoded
features.description: Binary encoding of dwipd (distance/width indicator): g=1 (greater), l=0 (less) for positional distance measure
features.expected_model_benefit: Clean binary encoding of positional distance feature for linear SVM boundary

features.name: wtoeg_encoded
features.description: Binary encoding of wtoeg (white to edge): t=1 (true), n=0 (neutral) indicating white king edge proximity
features.expected_model_benefit: Edge proximity binary feature contributes to linear margin for endgame position assessment

features.name: rare_event_composite
features.description: Sum of rare tactical events: hdchk, skach, reskd, thrsk, mulch, stlmt, qxmsq, skrxp which occur infrequently but may be decisive
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregating rare decisive events into one feature reduces sparsity while preserving signal for SVM

features.name: white_vs_black_advantage_differential
features.description: Difference between white tactical advantage score and black king vulnerability score, representing net positional balance
features.expected_model_benefit: Signed differential directly encodes relative advantage as a continuous value ideal for SVM hyperplane

features.name: overall_position_complexity
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall position complexity based on number of active tactical features, rare events, and interaction patterns. Higher values indicate more complex positions with multiple simultaneous threats and counter-threats that are harder to resolve deterministically.
features.expected_model_benefit: Complexity score helps SVM identify positions where simple heuristics fail and more nuanced boundary is needed

features.name: endgame_decisiveness_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of how decisive the endgame position is, considering king placement indicators (wkcti, wkna8, wkpos), rook activity (rimmx, rkxwp), and pawn-related features (bkxwp, blxwp, rkxwp). Higher values indicate positions closer to forced outcomes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Decisiveness measure provides smooth continuous signal for SVM to distinguish near-forced from unclear positions
